regions.merged_text: God bless you Miss Muriel Krausman. I hope you keep well. You've been on my mind for ten days, - wanting acknowledge your favor of Apr. 4th. Well you remember how it was with me when I was up there in January. It is not audiences with callers now but answering letters that is my problem. So please have charity to overlook tardiness, etc. I thank you just the same and pray for you even though I fail to write. Many thanks again.
